pattern_explanation: Both languages draw on Latin and Greek roots, so the forms look alike, but several Polish technical and media terms have shifted in meaning.
false_friend_warning: The Polish word for an expert report looks like English 'expertise', which means skill or knowledge; the Polish word for a computer screen looks like English 'monitor', which means to observe; and the Polish word for an app looks like English 'application'. Learners who translate these literally will choose the wrong English word.
